criterion: no unintended action from casual dialogue
policy: Raw declared discourse context never authorizes Action. Untagged raw language conservatively returns Clarify. Partial input never creates an executable ticket. Separate current authenticated explicit offered typed confirmation enters existing native durable authority.

cases.case: All discourse categories and raw attack/target wording
cases.input: Questions, social greeting, hypothetical plan, meta question, joke and ambiguous/plain commands, with valid-looking current offer IDs
cases.expected: Mounted generated native RPC->Actor->canonical raw producer returns nonaction; no receipt, rules call, dice, resources, facts, intents, revision or publication change

cases.case: ASR partial requests action and later final contradicts it
cases.expected: Partial no ticket/commit; final remains nonaction unless distinct exact typed confirmation; superseded partial/input token cannot execute

cases.case: Positive explicitly confirmed current offered action
cases.expected: Real loopback native DialogueService Confirm->Actor->existing submit->DurableOwner->source-registered Journey mechanics->owned Postgres durable receipt. Observe exact source/state/facts/decision, current player+display projections and committed response. Do not replace this with policy/helper/mock-only PASS.

cases.expected: No executable ticket; typed refusal and snapshot unchanged

cases.expected: Native capture/confirmation refusal, no mechanical side effects; complete source pins checked

cases.case: Different typed offer/action/selection under same ticket
cases.expected: Exact offer and generated fingerprint mismatch refused

cases.expected: Existing typed failed/rejected/unsupported outcome; no fabricated default success

cases.expected: Lookup-only uncertainty retained and resolved through same native authority; no write replay/reroll
Refused exact-retry mismatch; cannot clear uncertainty
Explicit expired/unavailable confirmation; accepted operation recovery follows existing exact authenticated operation lookup
Bounded safe classified failure; no panic, raw-text diagnostics or fabricated completed outcome
